The oldest tg3 devices had large rx producer ring BD caches.  Back then
it made sense to make the BD cache replenish threshold only a function
of the number of rx buffers posted by the driver.  Since then
cache sizes have shrunk to 25% of their original size and

column2: the ring sizes have quadrupled in size.  Under such conditions

column1: static BD cache replenish thresholds no longer match the hardware
This patch attempts to factor in the BD cache size into the bd cache

column2: taking the existing hardware bugs into account.
